Guides / Progress & money / The Professor

The Professor

Sending duplicates, what each one pays, and release.

Send duplicates to the Professor from the PC (or let Catch rules do it). Of each species + look (+ costume) your best one stays: highest IVs first, then level. Protected Pokémon (see Catch rules) never go automatically.

Never send list: species you add in Catch rules → Never send → Species (up to 60), or with the lock on their Pokédex page, keep every copy: auto-send and Send duplicates skip them all. You can still pick one in the PC and press Send yourself (the game gives you a heads-up first).

Plain commons & uncommons
A flat $100 (Common) / $150 (Uncommon), at any level (plain = no Shiny / Void / Prismatic look, not perfect, not an Alpha)
Cash (everything else)
level × 6 × 1 (Common) / 1.5 (Uncommon) / 3 (Rare) / 5 (Legendary) × (5 per special look) × 3 (perfect) × 2 (Alpha)
Every Pokémon
1 family Candy (+1 Rare, +4 Legendary, +2 special look)
Every 30 sent
1 Rare Candy
Extras
Legendary: 1× Rare Candy; Shiny: 1× Rare Candy; Void: 5× Ultra Ball; Prismatic: 1× Big Nugget; Perfect: 2× Rare Candy
Rare Pokémon
25% chance of an evolution stone

A calculator runs in the live wiki. Open this page in the live wiki to use it.

Release

Releasing pays level × 4 money (×10 for a special look). Its held item and Mega Stone come back to the Bag.

Rare Candy into Candy

The Get button on a Pokémon's card turns Rare Candy into Candy for that family: 3 each (1 for a legendary family).
